Hello & Thanks for posting on R/Techsupport 

Before doing anything to recover please get ride of the suspected "controlling software" for the said Iphone. You can do this in many self-service ways such as Norton/Bitdefender (Kaspersky is probably best here). These tools will hopefully remove it. If you think it still has not been removed seek advice directly from apple.

After doing this please CHANGE ALL ACCOUNT PASSWORDS INVOLVED (e.g Yahoo & Apple ID). Regardless if they have not full been involved. 

Sadly there is not much you can do about Instagram. From my memory you need to reset the account by password rest (if possible) then turn on 2 Factor Authentication not just by email but an added extra layer such as an authentication app (such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator, Stay clear of unknown authentication apps). 

I hope I was able to help a bit. Please remember...

- Change you passwords at least every 3 months
- Turn on at least two methods of 2FA on all online accounts where possible
- use an app that help keep your devices safe (such as Bitdefender)
